title: A Site changes tab mounted behind another tab reads its list but does not mark it seen; shown again, it does
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/core/tracy-core/test/site-changes-undo-request.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/shown-again.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for 'a list read while its pane is hidden does not mark it seen; shown again, it does' and the four paneShown lines.
expect: Every test reports ok and the run ends with '# fail 0'.

The real ChangesView mounted with isShown() false reads GET …/activity but sends no PUT …/activity/seen (pre-fix: one PUT at mount); after isShown() turns true and reloadKey moves, exactly one PUT …/activity/seen.

paneShown is false for a pane with no layout boxes (display: none, the side card's unpicked tab), for a page whose visibilityState is 'hidden', and for no root; true for a laid-out pane in a page in front.
evidence: E2E dev 04/10 E9.2b (tasks/evidence/e2e-dev-0410/bugs.md item 8, E9/b-jo-unseen-2.json): seat B's /activity/unseen was 1; opening the Joomla workspace, whose layout keeps Site changes behind the Browser tab, moved B's watermark 9 s later and no badge was ever drawn. dsh-better-sidebar keeps every tab mounted (split-pane.tsx, paneTabHidden = display: none), and ChangesView marked the list seen on every read.
fence: ChangesView takes isShown() and moves the watermark only while it is true; tracy-site-tabs passes paneShown(root) (laid out and page visible); followShownAgain re-reads when the pane comes into view, and that read marks it.

tests: a list read while its pane is hidden does not mark it seen; shown again, it does
an unpicked tab (display: none, no boxes) is not shown
